descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-02 Encryption Verification · S18 「养老院交接：交接单 → Send 对话框 → 关闭 → 刷新，始终没有 email 选项」 Nursing Home handoff: sheet → Send dialog → closed → reload, never an email option

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U4 No email or mailto that carries patient data, on any screen that shows patient data, in Hospital and in Nursing Home: no PHI is transmitted through an unencrypted path. …（UAT OAT-02 step 3；UAT OAT-02；UAT 3.3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress
  • U5 The handoff and the task list leave the app only through the in-app Send to a signed-in RoundCompanion recipient, never to an email address (step 3 'in app only').（UAT OAT-02 step 3；TFA-92586 AC 6；TFA-92586 AC 7；TFA-92585 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress; TFA-92586 ready for pr; TFA-92585 ready for pr

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Local stack and the fixture Nursing Home resident, marked In Today by the agent

When Open the Nursing Home Handoff, wait for generation, open Send to…, wait until the colleague names are listed, close the dialog without sending, then reload. Opening Handoff makes one handoff-summary AI call per In Today resident on the local stack.

Then In every state there is no email, share, SMS, download or print control, no mailto: link and no email address offered as a recipient. Recipients are named app users only.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs per checkpoint: mustNotContain 'mailto:', 'Email', '/url: http:', 'sms:' and the role-qualified share/download/print names as in S10. The Send dialog mustContain 'Send handoff' and 'Dr. E2E Other', so the list was drawn, and mustNotContain 'Loading colleagues', 'No other RoundCompanion accounts yet' and '@roundai.test', meaning no address shown as a recipient (an ac …
